scenes.say: Are you double-checking API headers in your tests? Why does that even matter for interviews?

scenes.label: Metadata
scenes.sub: Headers carry info like content type, caching, and authentication.
scenes.say: Headers carry crucial metadata—things like content type, caching rules, and authentication details.
Here’s my checklist: First, check content type matches what you expect. Next, verify cache control follows your caching policy. And don’t forget to inspect any custom headers for accuracy.

scenes.title: API Response Headers
scenes.say: For example, a typical response might show content type as JSON, cache control set to no cache, and a custom request ID header.

scenes.question: Is header validation just for security?
scenes.right: No, it also ensures protocol compliance and correct metadata.
scenes.say: Don’t fall for this trap: header validation isn’t just about security. It’s also about following protocol standards and making sure clients get the right metadata.
